[USER] User is looking for new yoga poses to try at home.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested yoga poses that target core and legs:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Core Strengthening Poses:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Boat Pose (Paripurna Navasana): Sit with legs crossed, engage core, balance on seat bones, hold for 30 seconds to 1 minute.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Plank Pose (Phalakasana): Start in high push-up position, engage core, keep body straight, hold for 30 seconds to 1 minute.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Side Plank Pose (Vasisthasana): Lie on side with feet stacked, lift hips off ground, balance on forearm and side of foot, hold for 30 seconds to 1 minute on each side.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Leg Strengthening Poses:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Warrior II Pose (Virabhadrasana II): Stand with feet wide apart, bend front knee, stretch arms out to sides, hold for 30 seconds to 1 minute on each side.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Tree Pose (Vrksasana): Stand on one leg, other foot on inner thigh, engage core, lift arms up, hold for 30 seconds to 1 minute on each leg.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Eagle Pose (Garudasana): Stand with feet hip-width apart, bend knees slightly, cross one leg over the other, wrap arms around legs, hold for 30 seconds to 1 minute on each side.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Poses that Target Both Core and Legs:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Chair Pose (Utkatasana): Stand with feet hip-width apart, bend knees, lower body into squat, hold for 30 seconds to 1 minute.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Lizard Pose (Utthan Pristhasana): Start on all fours, step one foot forward, place hands beside front foot, lower back knee, hold for 30 seconds to 1 minute on each side.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Reminders: Listen to your body, breathe deeply, start slow, and gradually increase hold time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Happy practicing!
